name: How do I know if I need a log-home specialist instead of a regular painter?

mainEntity.name: How do I know if I need a log-home specialist instead of a regular painter?

acceptedAnswer.text: A professional should be able to show you the stain system they plan to use, explain how they handle prep, and tell you whether the finish is meant for logs, beams, and ceilings. For log homes in the Denver area, suppliers and restoration specialists commonly use log-specific products rather than standard interior paint.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a log-home specialist if you need proper prep, log-specific products, and even coverage on logs, beams, and ceilings. Regular painters may not handle log finishes the same way.
